title: No Ore Mining
description: I hate mining in those creepy caves!
body:
Don't you hate mining in those creepy caves? I do!  
That's why I made this mod to generate tiny ore splitters on the ground which can be crafted into vanilla ores.
![Gold Splitter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/921cfba4e2ce88907e03a7ee8e52a99e26e714c6.png)
![Burning in furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6393ce9bcdda3935abe1a328ac68081b9abcdc0c.png)  
Future Plan:  
- Add ways to get mob drops
